[RB-FIBER-CUT#03] Fiber cut on a transport link > Differential diagnosis: Versus planned maintenance The alarms are identical: `LINK_LOS` plus `SITE_DOWN`. ... It starts with `MAINS_FAILURE` hours before the site goes down and has no `LINK_LOS`. ... `LINK_LOS` with availability at zero is a hard failure. Check `nodes.attrs.medium`: a microwave link can also fail hard, and the data then looks like a fiber cut, although the repair is different. ...
[RB-FIBER-CUT#01] Fiber cut on a transport link > Overview: A transport link (node type `transport_link`, id like `LNK-XXX-NN-A`) carries all the traffic of the sites behind it, usually three to five. When the fiber is cut, or the optic or port on the link fails, every one of those sites loses its backhaul at the same moment. The sites themselves are healthy. ... Repairs take from about two hours to most of a working day.
[RB-FIBER-CUT#02] Fiber cut on a transport link > Signature in the data: Alarms. A `LINK_LOS` alarm, severity `critical`, on the link node at time t0 ("no light received on uplink port"). ... KPIs, every cell of every downstream site, same 15-minute step. ... Twenty to sixty minutes before the cut a minor `LINK_DEGRADED` alarm may appear on the same link with falling optical receive power. It marks a failing fiber or optic and is part of the same incident. ...
[RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#03] Microwave link degradation > Differential diagnosis: ... Versus a fiber cut A cut gives availability 0, `LINK_LOS` critical and `SITE_DOWN` on every site. ... Versus a fiber link starting to fail On a fiber link, a minor `LINK_DEGRADED` with falling optical power can precede a cut by up to an hour. If volume then goes to zero and `LINK_LOS` appears, the cut is the incident and the degraded alarm is its precursor. Versus congestion ...

# Transport Link Failure Affecting S-SAH-008

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SAH-01-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of LINK_LOS on the parent transport link matching the exact timeline of site outages. Configuration changes, maintenance windows, and external events were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-15 23:45 to 2026-09-16 02:57
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-15 23:53
- **Affected:** S-SAH-008, S-SAH-006, S-SAH-010

## Summary

Fiber transport link failure (LINK_LOS) on LNK-SAH-01-A causing total loss of backhaul for S-SAH-008 and its sibling sites.

Total loss of service for S-SAH-008 and sibling sites S-SAH-006 and S-SAH-010 between 23:45 on 2026-09-15 and 02:57 on 2026-09-16.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-15 23:08: Minor LINK_DEGRADED alarm raised on LNK-SAH-01-A [ALM-000333]
- 2026-09-15 23:45: Service anomaly alert ALR-0025 starts for S-SAH-006, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-010 [ALR-0025, ANM-000185, ANM-000191, ANM-000192]
- 2026-09-15 23:53: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on LNK-SAH-01-A [ALM-000335]
- 2026-09-15 23:54: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-006, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-010 [ALM-000336, ALM-000337, ALM-000338]
- 2026-09-16 02:54: LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-SAH-01-A [ALM-000335]
- 2026-09-16 02:57: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SAH-010, marking recovery of all affected sites [ALM-000338]

## Evidence

- S-SAH-008 experienced zero availability and active users from 23:45 on 2026-09-15 [T1, ANM-000185, ANM-000191, ANM-000192, ALR-0025]
- Parent transport link LNK-SAH-01-A suffered a critical LINK_LOS alarm simultaneous with the site outages [T2, T3, ALM-000335]
- Three sibling sites (S-SAH-006, S-SAH-008, and S-SAH-010) went down simultaneously due to the shared parent link [T2, ALR-0025, ALM-000336, ALM-000337, ALM-000338]
- No changes, maintenance windows, or external events occurred during the incident window [T4, T5, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-01-A: confirmed. Direct evidence of a transport fiber link failure (LINK_LOS) matching the timing and affecting all downstream sites. [T3, ALM-000335, RB-FIBER-CUT#01, RB-FIBER-CUT#02]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were executed on the affected nodes or their ancestors during the incident window. [T4]
3. **planned_maintenance**: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled for the affected nodes or their ancestors during the incident window. [T5]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000341: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-SAH-010 occurred well after the incident recovery at 05:18 and is unrelated to the transport outage.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-SAH-01-A for intermittent physical damage or degradation given the precursor LINK_DEGRADED alarm.
